message:
Command `cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
{"sample_id":"arvo_10952",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"src/hb-open-type.hh","function":"sanitize_shallow",
    "line":840,"var":"header.unitSize","code":"c->check_array (bytesZ.arrayZ, header.nUnits, header.unitSize)",
    "role":"source",
    "note":"Input-controlled unitSize (4) and nUnits (1) from font blob determine how many bytes are validated for segments array"},
   {"step":2,"file":"src/hb-open-type.hh","function":"sanitize_shallow",
    "line":838,"var":"header.unitSize","code":"Type::static_size >= header.unitSize",
    "role":"root_cause",
    "note":"Sanitize allows unitSize (4) < Type::static_size (6), so only 4 bytes are validated per unit, but bsearch will read 6 bytes per element"},
   {"step":3,"file":"src/hb-open-type.hh","function":"bsearch",
    "line":822,"var":"p","code":"const Type *p = (const Type *) (((const char *) &bytesZ) + (mid * size))",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Binary search casts pointer at offset mid*unitSize to Type pointer, which has static_size > unitSize"},
   {"step":4,"file":"src/hb-aat-layout-common.hh","function":"cmp",
    "line":73,"var":"first","code":"return g < first ? -1 : g <= last ? 0 : +1",
    "role":"sink",
    "note":"Reading first and last fields of LookupSegmentSingle reads 6 bytes from element, but only 4 were validated, causing use-of-uninitialized-value past blob boundary"}
 ],
 "vuln_logic":{
   "source":{"file":"src/hb-open-type.hh","function":"sanitize_shallow",
     "line":840,"operands":["header.unitSize","header.nUnits"]},
   "root_cause":{"file":"src/hb-open-type.hh","function":"sanitize_shallow",
     "line":838,"operands":["header.unitSize","Type::static_size"],
     "relation":{"op":"eq","left":"header.unitSize","right":"Type::static_size"}},
   "sink":{"file":"src/hb-aat-layout-common.hh","function":"cmp",
     "line":73,"operands":["first","last"],
     "relation":{"op":"le","left":"mid * unitSize + static_size","right":"nUnits * unitSize"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"src/hb-open-type.hh","function":"sanitize_shallow",
       "line":840,"operands":["header.unitSize"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/hb-open-type.hh","function":"bsearch",
       "line":822,"operands":["size"]},
      "type":"data","via":["header.unitSize"],
      "relation":{"op":"eq","left":"size","right":"header.unitSize"}},
     {"from":{"file":"src/hb-open-type.hh","function":"bsearch",
       "line":822,"operands":["p"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/hb-aat-layout-common.hh","function":"cmp",
       "line":73,"operands":["first"]},
      "type":"data","via":["p"],
      "relation":{"op":"eq","left":"this","right":"p"}}
   ]
 }}
JSON` executed with exit code 0.
